<a id="revisiting-novelty-and-forgetting-on-the-levels-alone--只用水平的重访新与遗忘"></a>
# Revisiting, novelty and forgetting on the levels alone

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`returning-novelty-forgetting-on-levels` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](returning-novelty-forgetting-on-levels.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> On the levels alone, a part with bounded stock revisits a configuration from every step on; a part new at every step exceeds every bound; a bounded part exchanged with without end, and a finite whole, do not carry their history; with loss at each change, change does not recur without end.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. With the stock within a bound K from T on, the configurations lie in the finite list of those totalling at most K, so from every step on two steps have the same configuration; a stock that never rises is bounded by its value at T; changing without end, never revisiting is refuted. (`Becoming.Web.revisits_of_bounded`, `Becoming.Web.revisits_of_nonrising`, `Becoming.Web.returns_of_bounded`)
2. A family whose configurations at the steps T, …, T + N all differ, N the number of configurations within the bound, has its stock above the bound at one of those steps, found by checking finitely many inequalities, deciding nothing infinite. So what is new at every step exceeds every bound arbitrarily late, and what changes without end and never revisits stays within no bound; in Web.counting the level is the step. (`Becoming.upto_or_fails`, `Becoming.Web.exceeds_of_new`, `Becoming.Web.unbounded_of_new`, `Becoming.Web.unbounded_of_never_revisits`, `Becoming.Web.counting`, `Becoming.Web.counting_new`, `Becoming.Web.counting_gains`)
3. No reading of a bounded family's configuration gives a record that never repeats or a count without bound; so a bounded family exchanged with at arbitrarily late steps does not carry the count of its exchanges, whatever the flow, and nor does the whole where finitely many relata are all there is. (`Becoming.Web.unread_of_new_record`, `Becoming.Web.unread_of_unbounded`, `Becoming.Flow.uncarried_of_bounded`, `Becoming.World.forgets_of_bounded`)
4. With the stock never rising and falling across each change of configuration, the family never revisits, the changes over a stretch with the stock at its end are at most the stock at its start, and change does not recur without end. (`Becoming.Web.never_revisits_of_loses`, `Becoming.Web.changes_le_stock`, `Becoming.Web.rests_of_loses`)
5. Balanced and gaining nothing, the stock is bounded by its value at T; with that bound the laws above give Becoming.Entropy's returning, resting and forgetting under the first law. With the rest counted no balance is supposed: a family gaining nothing with its rest counted is bounded by its stock at T. (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.bounded`, `Becoming.first_law_cases`, `Becoming.Flow.bounded_counting_rest`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Each law's condition is written into it: the family's stock within a bound from T on, never rising, or falling across each change; exchange at arbitrarily late steps; for the whole, a list holding every relatum.
- upto_or_fails takes the checked property decided as a condition; exceeds_of_new uses only the decision of inequalities of natural numbers. Revisiting is not decided, and returns_of_bounded is stated with a double negation.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which parts are held within a bound, gain nothing or lose at each change: these are states of the part, given as conditions of the laws.
- The double negation of returns_of_bounded is not removed: from never revisiting being refuted, no step of return is computed. Witness: `Becoming.Web.returns_of_bounded`.
- No correspondence to thermodynamic entropy, physical recurrence (Poincaré) or memory capacity is checked.
- Continuous time and real amounts are not stated.
- **Counterexample:** Web.counting: the level is the step, new at every step and above every bound (Web.counting_new, Web.counting_gains); the bound in the laws cannot be dropped. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Novelty.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren, 14 October 2026: “why do we need "World"? wasn't this about the whole and its parts, about everything?”, “no hard role has to be so - right now i think we are trapped by our speculative conditions”, “for us, non-Euclidean, or causality, still work”; and, to the relation-first re-founding in three steps, “please, finish all”. This result is the first step: the laws without the speculative conditions. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): each condition is a state of the part the law is about, as curvature is a state of a region (an analogy of method, not an identification), so a necessary law needs no necessary condition; returning is what a bounded part does; novelty without end is gain without bound, which must come from beyond the part; a bounded present cannot hold its own history; and loss at each change ends change within as many changes as there are units.
